name: Glider
about: Fretless keyboard: slide in pitch, effects on the vertical
padAria: Glider {range}: slide your finger — left is lower, right is higher; up — {fx}
noAudio: Sound isn’t available in this browser
hold: Hold the sound while the finger stays
soundHint: “Same as piano” is the sound set up in the piano (preset and knobs). Without hold, the sound fades like a real piano.
snapHint.free: Any pitch between notes — like a violin or a fretless neck. Playing in tune is up to your ear.
snapHint.magnet: The sound is pulled to the nearest note, but you can still glide smoothly between notes. Good for melodies and glissandos.
snapHint.note: Only notes of the scale sound; moving between them uses the chosen glide time.
widthHint: Width is sensitivity: fewer notes on screen means more room for each one and easier aiming.
fxHint.bright: Higher up the sound is brighter (a resonant filter), lower down it’s softer and darker.
fxHint.vib: The higher the finger, the deeper the vibrato.
fxHint.vol: Loud at the top, quiet at the bottom.
fxHint.trem: The higher the finger, the deeper and faster the volume pulse.
